overview: Once classmates Petar, Strahinja, and Lazar reunite for their prom anniversary and are forced to face old wounds during one turbulent night.

This film looks at two individuals who didn’t just dominate their era – they created one. overview: Best friends and train stewardesses Tess and DeeDee trade their dreary shifts on the Stank Rail for the glitzy Glamazonian Express. overview: A married couple’s life unravels when the wife’s cousin moves in. The husband realizes she’s the stripper he secretly met before, sparking temptation, deception, and fear of exposure.

overview: Police pull over a woman who claims she just gave birth. But the baby — and the blood — aren't hers. Twisted lies unravel in this true-crime documentary.

title: Haunted 3D: Echoes of the Past
overview: A man seeks refuge in a remote Indian mountain mansion, fleeing his past. He discovers the house harbors sinister secrets, pain, and terror ready to torment him.

overview: After choosing love over privilege, Yuan Xinyi and Liang Jingtian begin a life together without the support of her family. But as financial pressures mount and reality sets in, their once-unshakable romance is put to the ultimate test.

title: Badland Rising
overview: An ordinary bloke embarks on a 19-hour drive home, unaware of being pursued by two unhinged criminals. Once he discovers their motive, his journey turns into a brutal fight for survival.

overview: Maddalena has it all: a job she loves, the perfect fiancé, and a dream wedding ahead. Yet in the bedroom, something feels wrong. Urged on by her inner voice, embodied by pornstar Valentina Nappi, she begins to question her life. Meeting Bruno, a gardener with a troubled past, leads her to rediscover herself and realize the only path worth following is her own.

title: Roberto Zucco
overview: One night, Roberto Zucco escapes from the prison where he was incarcerated for the murder of his father. Thus begins a dizzying escape, punctuated by encounters that illustrate a quest for identity.

As inflation rises, fuel runs low, and panic spreads, Raman must navigate political pressure and a collapsing system to prevent the country from falling apart.

title: Chalien Kahin
overview: Two parallel life. living in same city, going through Same problems and have Same desire - To go back HOME.

overview: This story follows our protagonist Henry's battle with grief and depression. Trying to use faith and forgiveness to move on with his life.

title: Have you seen any fireflies?
overview: Have you seen any fireflies?

overview: Inside Cama Hospital, one of the sites targeted during the 2008 Mumbai terror attacks, nurses, ward boys, cleaners, lift operators, security personnel, and administrative workers keep 400 people alive while armed assailants struck the city around them.

overview: A young woman awakens from a coma grievously injured, memory fractured, her husband arrested. But as she puts together the pieces of her past, she starts to question her own actions — and her perception of reality.

overview: The highlight of the summer in Västerköping! Gunnar and Marianne celebrate traditionally with the children, herring, schnapps and Gunnar's own kubb rules. For Terese, "7 kinds of flowers under the pillow" brings unexpected consequences and opportunities.

overview: A stoner buddy-dramedy between a Jewish grandmother and her trans grandchild on a day trip to Cape Cod during the off-season.

There, they grow close to their neighbors, the Halbergs, whose warmth offers the promise of a fresh start. But the fragile peace begins to unravel when the Gheorghius' young daughter, Elia, arrives at school covered in bruises.

title: The Withering
overview: After an elderly woman discovers a mysterious amulet that restores her youth by draining the life from those around her, her caregiver must stop her as an entire town withers in a grotesque battle over renewal and the terror of aging.

title: The Roots
overview: After a decade in Canada, a Bangladeshi immigrant Akash returns to Bangladesh with his child, seeking to reconnect with his abandoned family and past. But time has reshaped everything—relationships have faded, and home feels distant. Struggling with identity and belonging, he confronts the silent weight of migration and the ache of return. Feature Film ‘The Roots’ is a poignant exploration of identity, nostalgia, loss, and the search for home across two worlds.

title: Quantum Entangled
overview: When two strangers find themselves connected in bizarre and unusual ways, they learn their souls are entangled at the quantum level.

overview: When a grieving father is diagnosed with terminal cancer, his desperate attempts to reconnect with his estranged sons force them all to confront the weight of loss, love, and the inevitability of being left behind.

Night after night he searches for answers, but the closer he gets to the truth, the less it seems to make sense. Soon the line between watcher and watched begins to dissolve.

title: My Name Is Rafaela
overview: Rafaela, a 19-year-old transgender girl, finds herself torn between two identities: Rafaela, the woman she sees herself as, and Daniel, the man those around her perceive her as. While navigating her college life and engaging with friends and a romantic interest, this dissonance generates increasing internal confusion, leading her to question who she truly is and how she wants to be percieved.

overview: Three girls try to flee their village to escape the superstitions and fanatic hostility surrounding them. Only the blind girl makes it out, finding herself face-to-face with an elephant.

title: Ramli's Photocopy
overview: At a small photocopy shop, Ramli spends his days reading fragments of other people's lives through the documents they leave behind. When a former high school acquaintance he once adored unexpectedly reappears, their growing friendship stirs old dreams, buried disappointments, and quiet questions about identity, failure, and the lives we choose to present to others.

title: Remember Death
overview: After a terminal diagnosis, Charlie realises that her time is near, leaving her with only a few weeks left to live. But she soon realises that death isn't unseen like she thinks.

title: Keu Na Januk
overview: A young man dreams of becoming a renowned photographer instead of taking a regular job, but while his father sees him as irresponsible and unsuccessful, only his girlfriend continues to believe in him as he struggles against a series of setbacks.

title: 40 Dates and 40 Nights
overview: Burned out on dating and ready to quit, Leah accepts her grandma's outrageous challenge: 40 dates in 40 nights for a full year of rent. From awkward dinners to unexpected sparks, she discovers the biggest obstacle to love might just be herself.

title: Perfect Love
overview: At the brink of giving up on all human connection, a painfully inhibited young woman meets a self-loving stranger at New York's Coney Island, inspiring her to ride a rollercoaster–for real and in her own bedroom...

title: Bride Beyond
overview: It follows a forensic doctor and a security commander investigating a ghost story linked to an old debt and a mysterious wedding.

overview: Nick and Noah are both embarking on life-changing adventures that are threatening to pull them apart—Nick in business with his father and Noah starting a fresh chapter at Oxford University. Now living separate lives, and meeting new people, they find themselves entangled in temptations, rivalries, and betrayals and their bond is tested like never before. As secrets unravel and temptation rises, they must fight to hold onto each other—or risk losing everything.

title: Leviticus
overview: Two teenage boys must escape a violent entity that takes the form of the person they desire most — each other.

title: Jim Queen
overview: When Heterosis - a mysterious virus that turns gay men straight sweeps through the Parisian gay scene, Jim, the six packed sovereign of the Gym Queens, goes from Pride royalty to social outcast. With only Lucien, a freshly-out twink with more heart than abs, still by his side, Jim must race to find a cure before the disease erases the community that once worshipped him.

title: Checkout: The Movie
overview: The supermarket workers leave the sleepy supermarket in Yavneh for a crazy adventure in which they are accused of a serious crime in a plot that begins in a detention cell and countinues with an escape story of Shefa Isasschar in an attempt to save their good name.

title: Extreme Makeover: Homer Edition
overview: Homer and Marge's fun couples' date night goes off the rails when Marge learns Homer left the kids unsupervised with only the doorbell camera as a babysitter. Frustrated with her imperfect husband, a tipsy Marge stirs up a trilogy of fantasies of a different Homer.

title: 40 Wacks
overview: When a group of friends wander into a long abandoned home they soon discover that a evil spirit is among them.

title: The Stories
overview: The Stories is a decades-spanning Egyptian family saga and love story set between the late 1960s and 1980s. The film follows Ahmed, a young man from a Middle-Class Cairo family who dreams of becoming a concert pianist. During the tense summer of 1967, as war looms over Egypt, he begins a pen-pal correspondence with an Austrian woman named Elizabeth (“Liz”). A semi-autobiographical film based on the director's parents and how they met.

title: No Hard Feelings
overview: Down-on-his-luck ride-hailing driver Li Song eases his frustrations via an obscure podcast, held back from new romance by an embarrassing chronic ailment. Yin, pretending to be a Korean customer service agent at a health-supplement firm, drudges through client calls to save for an apartment. A follow-up phone call draws these two lonely urban strangers together behind lies. As reality and delusion crumble, they are forced to confront life and their true selves.

title: Home Along da Riles: Da Reunion
overview: Years after Kevin Cosme's death, his children strive to uphold the values he taught them. Tensions arise when Bing announces her plan to marry her mysterious long-time boyfriend, prompting her brothers Bill, Bob, Baldo, and Estong to attempt to stop the wedding. Meanwhile, Azon, Kevin's widow, becomes saddened by the children's growing disunity and apparent abandonment of the values they were raised with, while imagining visions of Kevin as if he were still alive.

title: Luiza's Desert
overview: Luiza, a shy, awkward 15 year-old girl from Rio, dreams of being an artist. Her life is just starting to make sense when Luiza's world falls apart when her mother suffers an acute schizophrenic episode. Determined to hold her family together, Luiza must find the strength to face fear, loneliness and discrimination as she takes over the household and her mother's care.

title: MALWARE
overview: Led by a cybernetic soldier a group of exterminators in a fading zombie apocalypse have been sent to clear out an old infected zone long believed to be empty ... Or is it ?

title: Flies
overview: While trying to rebuild his life after a devastating loss, a young ghost writer enters an obsessive battle against a fly infestation that seems to manifest the weight of his own guilt.

title: Shana
overview: Shana navigates the trials and tribulations of everyday life with boundless energy and the support of her group of friends. When her grandmother passes away, she inherits a ring that is supposed to protect her from bad luck. Shana certainly needs this helping hand. Especially since her toxic partner has been released from prison, and misfortunes are piling up…

title: Toy Story 5
overview: When Bonnie receives a Lilypad tablet as a gift and becomes obsessed, Buzz, Woody, Jessie and the rest of the gang's jobs become exponentially harder when they have to go head to head with the all-new threat to playtime.

title: The Get Out
overview: A nightclub owner is on the verge of leaving his dangerous past behind for retirement with his girlfriend. When masked gunmen rob him and he finds himself squeezed by ruthless cartels, a mysterious newcomer arrives with an interest in buying the business. With danger closing in from all sides, he must navigate a deadly web of deception, power, and survival  -  where escape may no longer be an option.

title: Little Brother
overview: A tightly wound realtor's picture-perfect life gets an extreme makeover when his lovably chaotic "little brother" suddenly reappears.

title: Maa Inti Bangaram
overview: Through both her moments of fear and bravery, a woman discovers that embracing her vulnerabilities is as vital to her inner strength as facing challenges head-on.

title: Girls Like Girls
overview: Coley, 17, from rural Oregon, navigates intimacy after her mother's passing. Meeting Sonya sparks new feelings, but self-doubt hinders their connection. Sonya, unfamiliar with dating girls, is uncertain. They learn to embrace emotions.

title: The Death of Robin Hood
overview: Grappling with his past after a life of crime and murder, Robin Hood finds himself gravely injured after a battle he thought would be his last. In the hands of a mysterious woman, he is offered a chance at salvation.

title: Strung
overview: A talented violinist's prestigious new role as a music tutor for an enigmatic, elite family spirals into a psychological battle for her safety and sanity.

title: Cerita Lila
overview: Two twins named Lila and Lili. Both experienced tragic ends after alleged abuse by their own mother, Rahma. However, death does not immediately end their story. In another realm, Lila continues to search for her twin sister, Lili, who was separated from her. This search then leads Lila into a greater mystery that has been hidden. In addition to facing a deep sense of loss, Lila also tries to understand the reasons behind the tragedy that destroyed their lives. Meanwhile, mysterious figures begin to appear and reveal that there is a greater power deliberately hiding the truth.

title: Unraveled
overview: Maria is a former elite swimmer and famous sports commentator whose life unravels when her beloved husband Mikael, her former coach and father of their daughter, is suddenly suspected of sexual abuse. Sparking the scandal and media interest is the revelation in an upcoming book, of a young girl’s misguided infatuation for her swimming coach, with rumors suggesting that Mikael is the man in question.

title: Робоняня
overview: Cheerful and inventive Zlata, who stays at home alone for the sake of the school ball and the first kiss, under the supervision of the newest robot nanny Notrix. Confident that she can easily trick the car, Zlata soon discovers that she is dealing with an invulnerable opponent who controls the entire house. Desperate, she and her neighbor Nikita, who is in love with her, find an unconventional way out - they begin to communicate with the robot in its language, using "perfect promts". Their friendship with their iron friend is rapidly gaining momentum and leads to a huge party, which turns into real chaos. It is at this moment that Zlata has to make a choice and understand what true friendship and self-sacrifice are.

title: Slackers
overview: A slingshot is loaded, the stone flies and crashes - the neighbor's window breaks. Ramona and Nico are friends, lazy bums and fresh out of school. But instead of thinking about their future, they prefer to let the hot Berlin summer get the better of them. When they release a beloved neighbor's bird, they have to flee - into the politically charged world that they really don't want to be in. A road trip through Berlin begins - but on foot.

title: Silent Flood
overview: Set by a beautiful river canyon in Western Ukraine, a pacifist community with unique religious beliefs, sees their peaceful way of life gradually distressed by regular floods and eventually an unexpected war.

title: Maiin Haan
overview: Inspired by true events from 2007, Main Haan follows Seerat, a young woman haunted by an unseen presence after moving to Delhi. As terrifying incidents escalate, a shocking truth emerges—a restless spirit is using her to reveal an unfinished story connected to Sarab, the man she loves.

title: Nuclear Boy
overview: The lonely 17-year-old outcast Aike craves attention and finds it online where he conducts dangerous chemistry experiments. Hoping to pull Aike out of his internet bubble, his mother, a hardworking nurse, sends him to the scouts to make real friends. When that fails, Aike feels rejected and hurt. To prove himself to the world, he begins his biggest experiment yet: he secretly builds a nuclear breeder reactor in his mother's shed, encouraged by a growing group of internet followers.

title: Atlantic Rhapsody
overview: Ding Mao, a supermarket employee, accidentally cooks the ornamental shark kept in the store. Soon after, he starts hearing a strange voice. Travelling from a southern city to the wilds of Northeast China, he sets out to trace his father’s whereabouts. During this journey, he pieces together his father’s bizarre life through an abandoned amusement park, a zoo in winter, and the supermarket where shark meat is sold. A quirky experimental musician, a blind fortune-teller who can understand animal language, a trainer whose legs were bitten off by a shark, and a female picture book painter — guided by the mysterious voice, all these souls become intertwined.

title: Anna Reads for Delilah
overview: An actor shows up for the last audition of the day; the director's last chance to get the performance he wants.

title: ELEFANTE
overview: Maria reunites with her friend Eliza after a long time, however, the discomfort and tension between them quickly grow when the topic of Eliza's pregnancy comes up.

title: Anna is Still Reading for Delilah
overview: An actor refuses to let her audition end until she gets the line just right.

title: Meet Me in the Margins
overview: A book editor secretly pens her own romance manuscript, only to find unexpected editorial notes from a mysterious critic in the margins. The film is a witty, heartwarming story about finding love between the lines.

title: Arborea
overview: In a near future, vegetation has mysteriously stopped reproducing.  A scientist monitors the sound frequencies of an oak tree, until one day she hears a new sound.

title: Sathyathil Sambhavichathu
overview: A long-standing legend speaks of treasure hidden beneath village ponds and wells, with only one man ever claiming to have found it. When clues about the lost treasure begin to surface, a series of misunderstandings, unexpected discoveries, and amusing consequences unfold, blending mystery with humor.

title: Citizen Vigilante
overview: A man takes justice into his own hands, hunting down criminals. His vigilante crusade makes him a social media star but puts him at odds with the local police chief.

title: I Know Who You Are
overview: On 1949 October 1, the day of the founding ceremony of the People's Republic of China, Xiao Dali enters the city and is reorganized as the director of the public security police station. He finds that primary school teacher Feng Jingbo is full of doubts. With the high vigilance of a soldier and the sense of responsibility of a public security official, Dali insists on partnering with Feng and becomes his neighbor. He then spends his whole life carrying out a nearly four-decade pursuit without regrets.

title: Voicemails for Isabelle
overview: A young woman's hilariously confessional voicemails to her late sister are unknowingly redirected to a stranger, who begins to fall in love from afar.

title: Husbands in Action
overview: A detective teams up with his ex-wife's new husband to chase down her kidnappers. Can this unlikely duo put aside their differences for one wild rescue?

title: Latina
overview: A story about a mysterious woman who shakes up a seemingly ordinary boarding house. As she charms both the boys and girls, secrets unravel, relationships collide, and chaos takes over.

title: Fatherland
overview: In 1949, German writer Thomas Mann and his daughter Erika embark on a road trip across a Germany in ruins, from US-dominated Frankfurt to Soviet-controlled Weimar.

title: Cocktail 2
overview: After a decade together, Diya and Kunal's relationship is shaken when Ally, an old friend, re-enters their lives. What begins as a plan between two women spirals into chaos, triggering hilarious, emotional rollercoaster none of them saw coming.

title: Virginia Woolf's Night & Day
overview: In 1910 London, independent-minded Katharine Hilbery defies her family's expectations of marriage to pursue a career in astronomy. But when her father pressures her into an unwanted engagement, her resolve is tested. Through new friendships—including a bold suffragette and a thoughtful editor—Katharine begins to question the limits placed on her by society, love, and tradition, ultimately searching for a path that is truly her own.

title: I am Jit Bahadur
overview: Jit Bahadur’s journey from a struggling dreamer to a celebrated actor reveals the harsh price of fame, as his relentless ambition gradually distances him from the very family that once supported him.

title: All of a Sudden
overview: Marie-Lou Fontaine, director of a nursing home in the Paris suburbs, defies convention by adopting the 'Humanitude' method despite her team’s resistance. Her encounter with Mari Morisaki, a terminally ill Japanese playwright, transforms her life. Together, they turn the facility into a symbol of resistance and humanity against the system’s limits.

title: Balan - The Boy
overview: A teenage boy searches for his missing mother following a turbulent childhood and her subsequent disappearance, exploring his search for closure and the truth about his past.

title: Transfer Trimurthulu
overview: Fearless cop Trimurthulu's chance find drags him into a web of conspiracy. Standing alone against influential enemies who will stop at nothing, he risks everything to expose the truth and deliver justice.

title: CMLL Presenta NJPW Fantastica Mania Mexico 2026

title: Strangers in the Mountain
overview: In the 1990s, two police officers ventured into the mountains along Zhejiang's Shanxi Stream to track down a suspect from an old case. As they dug deeper into the past, long-buried memories resurfaced, stirring poignant recollections among everyone involved about Zhang Xue, the person who had gone missing.

title: Dear Mothers!
overview: As three generations of Colombian women prepare for their daughter's quinceañera in London, the daughter faces the unexpected reality of her pregnancy and whether to reveal it on the day meant to honour her, risking a celebration that would forever change.

title: Mesdames Thanh Sắc
overview: Mesdames Thanh Sắc follows the intertwined lives of the captivating beauty Cầm Thanh (Thanh Hằng) and Madame Sắc (Hồng Ánh), the wealthy owner of the prestigious Kim Đô nightclub, renowned for her fortune and vast collection of diamonds. Though she rises through Madame Sắc’s ranks to become one of Saigon’s most celebrated dancers in the 1960s, Cầm Thanh longs to break free from her patron’s control. As their ambitions and desires collide, the two women become locked in a tense power struggle that sets off a series of shocking and far-reaching events.

title: Maddie's Secret
overview: Maddie is a plucky dishwasher who leaps to viral superstardom at a trendy food content creation company. While her life seems picturesque — complete with an adoring husband, ride-or-die best friend and a cupboard full of woman-owned ethically-sourced chili crisp to boot — mounting professional pressures threaten to reawaken a hidden secret from her troubled past.

title: You Are the Film
overview: The directorial debut of Makoto Ueda, the award-winning writer of such films as Beyond the Infinite Two Minutes, River, Night is Short Walk on Girl, etc

title: Alive
overview: After coming face to face with death, 40-year-old Nora is consumed by an urgent need to feel alive. She dives into passionate relationships with two very different men, Tom and Max, whose opposing natures reflect her own inner conflict. But when neither can fill the void, Nora is forced to face the truth, she will have to confront a deeper fear driving her hunger for life.

title: NJPW Road to G1 Climax 36 - Day 1
overview: The first night of Road to G1 Climax 36 was a professional wrestling event promoted by New Japan Pro Wrestling (NJPW) that took place on June 19, 2026, at Chino Cultural Complex in Chino, Nagano, Japan.

title: It's My Time
overview: Grandma Zhao Yanhong (Michelle Yeoh), whose mental state is "30 years ahead of her age," refuses to admit defeat, is fearless, and loves to cause trouble! After meeting the genius but ultimately useless Wu Youwei (Liu Haoran), who "would rather lie down than sit," she becomes involved with the Rubik's Cube, and together with her mentor, best friend, and family, stumbles and bravely ventures into the "Rubik's Cube world"! What kind of magic will she achieve after picking up a Rubik's Cube at 70? What bizarre opponents and chaotic unexpected events will she encounter...?

title: Effi o Blaenau
overview: Hard-partying young woman Effi lives in rural Wales, whose life largely revolves around drinking vodka with her friends and eating instant noodles to cure her subsequent hangovers – until her life suddenly changes dramatically.

title: Dark Giant
overview: Dark Giant is a Supernatural Horror and Psychological Family Drama. It Explores How Greed, Guilt, and Generational Trauma Can Manifest as a Literal Curse, Destroying a Family From the Inside Out

title: West by Northwest
overview: The film interweaves three RV travel stories across China, exploring themes of family connection, generational conflict, and finding closure among different age groups facing life's emotional and existential challenges.

title: Method Cowboy
overview: When a struggling actor feigns being gay to land the role of a lifetime in an Oscar-bait Cowboy Western, he decides to transform himself for the role, blurring the lines between reality and performance.

title: Loves Company
overview: Washed-up TV guest star Blake de Troy is rescued after a car crash by his devoted fan, Antoinette Funk, who lives in the Florida Everglades. Believing he's been kidnapped, Blake initially tries to escape, but after the death of his life partner and manager, Jimmy, he realizes he has nowhere else to go and begins exploiting the situation as a potential publicity stunt. Their increasingly dysfunctional arrangement spirals into a dark comedy about celebrity, loneliness, obsession, and fandom.

title: INDEPENDIENTE
overview: Three Mexican filmmakers — Max del Río, Gabriela Ivette Sandoval, and Hugo Villaseñor Alcázar — share their processes and challenges around a single question: How can an independent film get seen? Through the eyes of insiders, the documentary reveals the complex journey behind making cinema visible in Mexico.

title: Second Nature: Gender and Sexuality in the Animal World
overview: Did you know that clownfish change sex from male to female? (So if Nemo’s mom had died in real life, his dad could have become his mom!) Did you know that albatross, penguins and swans parent in same sex pairs? Or that bonobos, who are just as closely related to us as chimps, are matriarchal and have same-sex sex every day?!  Narrated by Elliot Page, Second Nature follows trailblazing Evolutionary Biologist Dr. Joan Roughgarden as she meets groundbreaking scientists exploring the 1500+ animal species who engage in same-sex sexual behavior and parenting, change sex, form matriarchies, and more,  debunking myths that females are “inferior” and that being queer is “unnatural.”  SECOND NATURE — everything you didn’t learn in high school biology.

title: The Love Heist
overview: Celebrity stylist Kayli must team up with hotel security chief Mills to track down an iconic piece of fashion history after it goes missing on her watch before the Chicago Costume Gala.

title: NJPW Yuji Nagata Produce Blue Justice XVIII
overview: Yuji Nagata Produce Blue Justice XVIII was a professional wrestling event produced by New Japan Pro-Wrestling (NJPW) and organized by Yuji Nagata. Held on June 20, 2026, at City Gymnasium in Kimitsu, Chiba, Japan, the annual Blue Justice show served as Nagata’s hometown charity event.

title: Safe In My Skin
overview: Mikey Liu, a young Chinese American man living in New York City, travels to his hometown for the funeral of his childhood friend, Shaun. As the trip pulls him back into his past, long-buried memories begin to surface, revealing the quiet weight of a complicated friendship.

title: Oliver West
overview: West Knight secretly helps Oliver, a ghost only she can see, cross over to the afterlife before his spiritual essence deteriorates completely. While her step sibling Jaime navigates a new romance with coworker Quinn, West discovers that Oliver's unfinished business isn't about supernatural rituals—it's about experiencing human connection and love.

title: Spare Queens
overview: In bowling, there is nothing more daunting than the 7-10 split, which leaves two side pins in a position that is almost impossible to knock down. In this stirring sports film, the infamous split serves as a metaphor for not only a long-standing rivalry between two retired female bowlers, but also rare second chances to correct past mistakes. Produced by the team behind sleeper hit Love Lies (2024), this directorial debut shows us that bowling involves far more than just hitting wooden pins with a ball – it requires precise timing, immense strength, and grace under pressure.

title: La Fête de la Musique à Orange
Jenaka
overview: Andra has to carry out his mother's request to take care of his half sister, Jenaka, despite the circumstances that force him to live in his car. However, he faces an internal conflict as Jenaka's innocence slowly breaks down the barriers he built.

title: The Next Karate Kid
overview: Twelve-year-old Sasha is forced to leave Moscow for Pyatigorsk to live with his aunt while his doctor parents are on assignment in Africa. Local children, school bullying, and conflict with the leader, Marat, become part of his new life. When his parents disappear during a flood, the boy faces utter despair. Seeking strength, he discovers a passion-karate, where his strict sensei, Dmitriy, and his daughter, Masha, help him overcome his fears, develop his character, and find inner strength.

title: For the Love of a Woman
overview: 1970s. Esther, living in America, receives a mysterious letter after her mother's death. She is asked to locate a woman living in 1930s Palestine who is keeping a secret related to her life. Esther arrives in Israel and contacts Professor Zaida who will help her in her search.  1930s. Pioneer colony in the valley, a new world atmosphere. Moshe, a widower and father of two, hires a woman to help him maintain the house. The arrival of Yehudit stirs up his life and the lives of two other men: Yaakov, a romantic farmer, and Globerman, a cattle dealer.  In a romantic triangle, the threads between past and present intertwine and Esther and Zaida discover a shocking truth.

title: Nara
overview: Trapped in a constantly shifting reality, Nara launches a desperate pursuit of a mysterious figure she believes is the only way out.

title: NJPW Road to G1 Climax 36 - Day 2
overview: The second night of Road to G1 Climax 36 was a professional wrestling event promoted by New Japan Pro Wrestling (NJPW) that took place on June 21, 2026, at Sagamihara City Gymnasium in Sagamihara, Kanagawa, Japan.

title: Lifeline
overview: How far would you go, and what would you risk for the one you love? What drives Ananya, a city girl, to this distant village and where will her journey lead?

title: Black Annis
overview: Following a personal tragedy, Ann becomes aware of an eerie presence stalking her every move, as frightening changes begin to occur.

title: Luminesence
overview: In a ruined city consumed by a lethal entity of light, a partially blind teenager and his older sister fight to survive. But when a mysterious encounter disrupts their fragile existence, they are forced to face their deepest fears and long-buried desires.

title: Please
overview: A dark comedy about humankind’s desire to love and to be loved. Centred around neediness, intimacy and romance.  Told through a series of loosely connected, tender and absurd scenes, the film follows people who are searching for closeness and acceptance. In a world that preaches self-control, the film explores the sides we try to hide, such as feeling needy and pathetic.  The stories overlap and reappear, gradually forming a portrait of collective longing.

title: Danse Macabre
overview: An apocalyptic nightmare about war and destruction, set to the Allegro from Shostakovich' 10th symphony.

title: Julián
overview: Wide-eyed Julián is about to spend the summer with a grandmother he barely knows. He is amazed to discover her treasure-trove apartment, his own Caribbean heritage and the lively Brooklyn community he is surrounded by. But most surprising of all, Julián discovers that he is, in fact, a mermaid!

title: The Welcome Table
overview: Tells the story of climate refugees across six continents, celebrating the voices and experiences of people living at the forefront of the climate crisis, displaced from their homes by climate disasters.

title: Blue
overview: Luce, a bright young student from a good family, falls for Loris, a reckless boy whose debts put them both in danger. She turns to Vittoria, a once-familiar friend now living in luxury, who convinces her to use erotic sites to pay off the debt. But, like dominos, every part of her life starts collapsing. The two girls won't leave until dawn, once Luce's debt is paid, but at what cost?

title: Batman: Knightfall Part 1: Knightfall
overview: Arkham Asylum has been destroyed, and all its inmates have been unleashed upon Gotham City. As Batman races to round up some of his greatest enemies, he is pushed to his physical and mental limits and into a final confrontation with a new threat: the man called Bane!

title: Rent Free
overview: He thought he found a place to stay rent free… but nothing in life is free.  Marcus, a smooth-talking hustler, moves in with Shay, a quiet therapist hiding a dark past. But when his plan to con her is exposed, he quickly realizes he’s not in control. Trapped inside her apartment, Marcus is forced into a twisted game where every move comes with consequences and escape may cost him everything.

title: Metanoia
overview: A poetic documentary dissecting the relationship between post-trauma identity and artistic expression, primarily through the life of a song.

title: Macbeth
overview: Macbeth has lived through countless feuds, loyally defending King Duncan's estate against increasing attacks. When a malevolent force offers Macbeth a future as king, encouraged by Lady Macbeth, they seize their fate, with grave consequences.

title: NJPW Road to G1 Climax 36 - Day 3
overview: The third night of Road to G1 Climax 36 was a professional wrestling event promoted by New Japan Pro Wrestling (NJPW) that took place on June 23, 2026, at Korakuen Hall in Tokyo, Japan. The show featured a four-way #1 contendership match for the IWGP Junior Heavyweight Championship and two G1 Climax 36 play-in matches.

title: Canada Day
overview: At a dive bar on Canada Day, a 21-year-old named Aria sparks a romantic connection with the very actress she caused to be cancelled for 6 years prior.

title: Les Parfait(s) : Arnaques en Famille
overview: The Toussaint family are expert hustlers on the run who adopt the unassuming identities of the “Perfects” and settle in Scotland. As they juggle new jobs, nosy colleagues and a mysterious neighbor, their elaborate disguises, gadgets and insane schemes threaten to expose their double life.

title: Car Crashes
overview: A Tinder date over cheap pizza devolves into a shit show.

title: Molière, Cyrano and the Young King
overview: During the Paris rebellion, young Louis XIV must be hidden from danger and is secretly replaced at court by a look-alike. Entrusted to the musketeer-poet Cyrano de Bergerac, Louis is sheltered within Madeleine Béjart’s traveling theater troupe, where the actor and aspiring playwright Molière has just joined – unaware their newest member is the future king of France. As Cyrano struggles to handle the arrogant and clumsy young king, he begins writing a bold play for the troupe. Molière, bursting with ideas, transforms the work with wit and heart, awakening his genius for comedy and deepening his secret feelings for Madeleine, while young Louis discovers the joy of theater and the power of friendship. But back in Paris, intrigue is brewing – can the young king return in time before the masquerade is revealed and embrace his true royal destiny?

title: Only Rebels Win
overview: Suzanne and Osmane meet in crisis-ridden Beirut. Osmane is a young Sudanese man without papers, searching for a better future; Suzanne is a widow with Palestinian roots more than twice his age. Against all odds, they fall in love.

title: Supergirl
overview: When an unexpected and ruthless adversary strikes too close to home, Kara Zor-El, aka Supergirl, reluctantly joins forces with an unlikely companion on an epic, interstellar journey of vengeance and justice.

title: Black Box
overview: A routine domestic flight turns into the flight from hell through a series of inexplicable phenomena and raw terror. Surreal encounters blur the boundaries between reality and nightmare. Passengers fight against all the odds in an attempt to survive while combating bizarre technological malfunctions, accelerating supernatural events and alien influences.

title: Welcome to the Jungle
overview: A group of quirky characters gets stuck in a dangerous jungle during a chaotic mission. Filled with confusion, criminals, and hilarious situations, they must work together to survive and find their way out.

title: Jackass: Best and Last
overview: The fifth and final installment to Jackass franchise where the crew go on one last insane crusade.

title: Jangan Buang Ibu
overview: Ristiana, a single mother, struggles to raise her three children after her husband left her with significant debt. Her decisions strain her relationship with her children. Despite the distance and longing, her three children remain devoted to their mother and strive to repair their relationship before it's too late.

title: Landslide
overview: Amidst the riots in Poso, Kai and his older brother, Ringgo, who has Down Syndrome, are separated from their mother, Emmy. While searching for their mother, they encounter a police officer named Idham, who is on duty handling the riots. Idham helps search for Emmy, while taking Kai and Ringgo along on his journey through dangerous situations. An emotional bond like family begins to emerge between Idham, Kai, and Ringgo.

title: Feed
overview: Five social media influencers spend a weekend at a forest retreat but inadvertently awaken and confront the world's first vampire.

title: Unboxing
overview: Popular blogger Vlad tries to attract attention to his concert in an original way - he puts himself up for auction. The lot immediately goes to the son of a rich businessman. Now Vlad is obliged to entertain Borya for a whole week. All attempts to break the contract run into huge fines, and then Vlad decides to really piss off Borya and make a video blog out of his life. In response, Borya arranges more and more new challenges for him.

title: Bisharashki in India: In Search of Mom
overview: The family travels to India to unravel the mystery of Adilet's past and find his mother.

title: Sugar Beach
overview: A brilliant yet haunted valedictorian seeks refuge in a passionate throuple, but when their intoxicating world unravels, she must confront her past before it destroys her.

title: The Djinn's Curse 2
overview: In a village at the foot of Mount Budo, Diana begins behaving violently after disappearing into the forest, forcing her husband Anas to kill her.

title: Berlin Kills Me
overview: Jacky (30), who lives in Berlin, falls into a deep void after the death of her mother and losing her job. Unable to succeed in her attempt to commit suicide, she decides to hire a hitman. Unbeknownst to her, she meets Çello (33), the killer assigned to commit murder. Çello and Jacky fall in love with each other. The loving couple decides to go into hiding, but their happiness doesn’t last long. A major confrontation takes place at Madam Bora’s Pissoir Bar.

title: After-School Exorcism Club: Girls' Night
overview: At Palja Girls' High School, where ominous energy seems to be part of the curriculum, strange incidents unfold one after another. The principal secretly recruits five girls whose fates are perfectly aligned, tasking them with a mission to exorcise ghosts haunting the school. After 30 years, the After-School Exorcism Club of Palja Girls' High returns!

title: Rescued
overview: A homeless man finds the motivation to turn his life around after a stray dog saves his life and refuses to leave his side.

title: Presagio
overview: A 16-year-old girl and her mother attempt to conceal the girl's biological maturity in a desperate plan to escape an oppressive community before she is forced to marry the elderly cult leader.

title: For Your Future Wife
overview: After leaving an aggressive voicemail post-breakup, a young man moves on to find the beauty in a new relationship while his ex-girlfriend struggles to find a new path after his abuse.

title: Headline
overview: One headline, countless questions, and the fight for a single truth. What lies hidden behind the overnight changed story?

title: Summerween
overview: A former circus clown escapes a mental institution on the tenth anniversary of his first kills. Now, as unsuspecting high schoolers throw a Summerween party at the clown’s abandoned mansion, a police officer and father to one of the party goers must rescue his daughter before the clown kills again.

title: Carry On Jatta 4
overview: A romantic deception spirals into household chaos when a family must construct an elaborate web of lies to conceal a secret relationship.

title: Crossing
overview: A retelling of the Red Army crossing the Chishui River four times to outmaneuver 400,000 enemy troops.

title: De Gaulle: Liberté
overview: Part two of a two-part biopic following French army officer Charles De Gaulle's life and political commitment between 1940 and 1945, and trace his development towards a political career.

title: Lucky Strike
overview: A wounded American soldier fights to survive behind enemy lines during WWII's Battle of the Bulge against the Germans, relying on his instinct, spy craft and a hand-radio to evade capture and find his way back to his unit.

title: FANTASIA
overview: Diana is an imaginative girl who constantly runs and builds her own world out of domestic trauma. She doesn't believe in love until she encounters the anonymous who called themself as "Dewa Eros" in a note on a romance novel. This journey leads Diana to meet Cinta, the true embodiment of love.

title: The Boy at the Edge of the World
overview: Omul lives with his family on a remote island in the Fire Archipelago. During a beach trip, a storm sweeps Omul and his younger sister Kimi into the sea, where Omul witnesses a mysterious creature threatening Kimi’s soul.  Rescued by a whale, the siblings survive, but Kimi is left in a coma. Omul’s ability to talk to animals becomes crucial as he and his brother – who blames him for the accident – set out to find Sadumea, the mythical figure behind Kimi’s torment.  With their dog Tela, they embark on a dangerous expedition deep into the island to save Kimi…

title: Eyes I
overview: A set of eyes of several women.

title: Madonna + Graham
overview: Graham Norton sits down with the 'Queen of Pop', singer-songwriter, record producer, actress, entrepreneur, charity founder and LGBT rights and gender equality activist Madonna. The pair discuss her lengthy career in which she has achieved 18 multi-platinum albums globally, seven Grammy Awards, two Golden Globe Awards, twenty MTV Video Music Awards and an induction to the Rock and Roll Hall of Fame.

title: The House Where People Don't Live
overview: Journalist Kristina is filming a documentary about a case of domestic violence in an old high-rise building. But it turns out that these walls hold many secrets, because evil has settled in the house.

title: Visitors of the Unknown
overview: When an experimental NASA probe crash-lands in their backyard, two siblings find themselves at the center of an extraordinary encounter with the unknown.

title: Jaand
overview: A guy sick of having only daughters toxic himself everyday with alcohol only to tear his family more than ever.

title: The Award Ceremony of the 31st Shanghai TV Festival Magnolia Blossom
overview: The 31st Shanghai Television Festival "Magnolia Awards" Ceremony  took place on June 26, 2026, at the Lingang Center in Shanghai. As one of the most prestigious and authoritative television honors in Asia, the Magnolia Awards celebrate exceptional achievements in TV broadcasting, acting, directing, and screenwriting.The 2026 edition evaluated outstanding Chinese dramas, variety shows, and international programs. The jury panel was highly globalized, featuring 15 industry professionals from seven countries, including Ireland, Germany, France, Malaysia, Singapore, Italy, and China.

title: Con City
overview: Follows a struggling family whose lives change when a receipt printer starts generating money after a lightning strike, leading to public chaos when society discovers the money-making machine.

title: Be Forever Yamato - Rebel 3199 - Part 6: Blue Labyrinth
Onekdin Por
overview: Framed as a river between two banks, the story follows a young woman balancing her home life and the elderly care center where she works, connected by her daily bus ride. As she forms a quiet bond with a fellow passenger, the lives of the aging residents reveal themes of loneliness, friendship, and the growing distance between generations.

title: &TEAM VR CONCERT : BOUNDLESS
overview: Captured by a mysterious organization, &TEAM is locked away in a secret laboratory. The moment their untamable nature awakens, they choose escape.  Encountering LUNÉ within the shadows of the city, they quietly reclaim their lost selves.  From 'Back to Life,' which awakens their wild instincts, through 'We on Fire,' where the wolves' energy burns bright, and finally to 'BUZZ LOVE,' where they finally rediscover their memories and emotions to share with LUNÉ!  The story that only truly begins after the escape.  <&TEAM VR CONCERT : BOUNDLESS>  We invite you into that world without boundaries.

title: Three Kingdoms: The Beginning
overview: Toward the end of the Eastern Han Dynasty, amid nationwide unrest, Cao Cao and Yuan Shao sought to enlist General-in-Chief He Jin’s support to check the power of the eunuchs and restore the Han Dynasty to its rightful order. Unexpectedly, Dong Zhuo seized the chaos to march his troops into the capital, plotting to dethrone the reigning emperor and install a new one.Swept up in the torrential tide of troubled times, a host of warlords emerged one after another: Yuan Shu, Lü Bu, Sun Jian, as well as Liu Bei, Guan Yu and Zhang Fei. Turmoil engulfed Luoyang, and the fate of the great Han Empire stood at a crossroads…

title: Ray
overview: Ray, a former gymnast-turned-pageant winner leaves behind the comfort of fame and privilege to take part in the Spring Revolution against Myanmar’s military dictatorship.

title: Yeah Nah
overview: Nellie and Eleanor both live with Obsessive Compulsive Disorder (OCD), navigating the weight of daily anxiety, finding connection in a most unexpected way.

title: WWE Night of Champions 2026
overview: The 2026 Night of Champions, also promoted as Night of Champions: Riyadh, was a professional wrestling premium live event produced by World Wrestling Entertainment (WWE) that took place on June 27, 2026, at Kingdom Arena in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia. The event featured the finals of the 2026 King and Queen of the Ring tournaments, along with championship matches for the WWE United States Championship and WWE Women's United States Championship. It was headlined by an Undisputed WWE Championship Triple Threat match between champion Cody Rhodes, Sami Zayn, and Gunther.

title: Red Chocolate
overview: A hidden communist cell and two young Jewish girls who risk everything to survive. Imre, the brilliant mathematician-philosopher, a cold manipulator, is not afraid to play with fire. Éva, the naive girl, flees World War II and the gendarmes with her sister Mária in 1944, but they quickly realize that the real danger is Imre and his housekeeper Eszter. Darker secrets come to the surface within the walls of the Oradea mansion. What happens when Imre promises not only protection, but also death? Jealousy, betrayal, escape and self-sacrifice, faith in the Creator and a piece of chocolate. Years later, his dark past catches up with the man in London. In 1975, a young girl, Elizabeth, reveals Imre's crimes, and the lies collapse. The story is unsparing and only one question remains: How does the horrors of war turn a man into a tyrant without hope and love?

title: Mind Games
overview: An unsettled therapist individually counsels both members of a troubled couple, becoming dangerously entangled in their relationship, to the point of her complete family uprooting.

title: St. Graves
overview: Former dirty cop Slade Crews is pulled back into a cold case when a masked killer known as “The Gravekeeper” begins murdering people in the small town of St. Graves. As bodies pile up, Slade uncovers a decades-old cover-up tied to corruption, betrayal, and a twisted story he hopes to unravel.

title: Blue Sands
overview: In a neon-drenched dystopia where lifespans are traded like currency, a dying man drags himself through the night in search of a second chance he may not deserve.

title: The Thrifty Angel
overview: Wei Yi (38), a stingy suona player from Sichuan Folk Orchestra, reluctantly takes in his neighbor's 6-year-old son A Yu. Through their unexpected bond, the miser gradually transforms.

title: Hamilton House
overview: A home of struggling actors will stop at nothing to create a haunted house to catch the eye of their new neighbor, a legendary horror filmmaker.

title: Hôtel Terminus
overview: December 31. The concierge of a luxurious seaside hotel deals with the guests' reactions after they learn about the imminent threat of a nuclear war.

title: Tales of the Bizarre: 2026 Summer Special
overview: The 2026 summer special of Fuji TV’s long-running anthology series presents four new strange tales. A veteran detective investigates a crime scene where evidence and bodies seem to vanish. A woman clearing her late mother’s apartment finds the past refusing to be thrown away. A young girl uses a mysterious costume to become an adult man. And a 26-year-old man discovers that his mother has been listed for auction online. Each story leads ordinary people into a surreal, unsettling world.

title: Trinkets
overview: A short film about the emotions and memories we associate to our personal belongings.

title: Two Armed Man
overview: A man must find his way out of trouble

title: When Grandma Becomes Grandpa
overview: After a sudden downpour in the park, caregiver Shelly accidentally wheels home the wrong person — only to find she has brought back a grumpy, uncommunicative grandpa instead of her client. As she scrambles to switch them back, the grandpa refuses to go home.

title: Raptor Attack
overview: Jevan moves her family into her late mother's home, only to discover her mother, Iris, a genetic scientist, created a deadly raptor that's now on the loose. As the creature hunts them, Jevan and her family must fight to survive and find a way to stop the ultimate predator.

title: AEW x NJPW x CMLL x Stardom Present Forbidden Door 2026
overview: The 2026 Forbidden Door was a professional wrestling pay-per-view (PPV) event and supershow co-produced by the American promotion All Elite Wrestling (AEW), Mexican promotion Consejo Mundial de Lucha Libre (CMLL) and the Japanese promotions New Japan Pro-Wrestling (NJPW) and World Wonder Ring Stardom (Stardom). It was the fifth annual Forbidden Door event and took place on June 28, 2026 at SAP Center at San Jose in San Jose, California, USA.

title: AEW x NJPW x CMLL x Stardom Present Forbidden Door 2026: Buy-In
overview: The Buy-In served as the pre-show for All Elite Wrestling's 2026 Forbidden Door event.

title: TNA Slammiversary 2026
overview: The 2026 Slammiversary is an upcoming professional wrestling pay-per-view (PPV) event produced by Total Nonstop Action Wrestling (TNA). It will take place on June 28, 2026, at the Agganis Arena in Boston, Massachusetts. It will be the 22nd event under the Slammiversary chronology, and will celebrate the promotion's 24th anniversary.

title: NXT The Great American Bash 2026
overview: The 2026 NXT The Great American Bash, also promoted as NXT The Great American Bash: Orlando, is a professional wrestling livestreaming event produced by WWE. It is the 14th Great American Bash under the WWE banner, the seventh annual produced specifically for its developmental brand NXT, and the 28th Great American Bash event overall.

title: PRODUCE: Volume 1
overview: PRODUCE celebrates the minds, bodies, and creative spirit of professional wrestlers. It’s wrestling that celebrates the talent, curated for fans who know ball, and those who’d like to learn—or learn to love it.  For this edition, PRODUCE features SUPERFIGHT, a headlining match between Jonathan Gresham and Fuminori Abe, plus appearances by Joey Janela, Effy, LaBron Kozone, Mance Warner, Steph de Lander, Man Like Dereiss, AEW Women’s Pure Champion Deonna Purrazzo, “Hot Sauce” Tracy Williams, Mad Dog Connelly, and many more.  PRODUCE is presented by Orange Crush, and co-produced by Jonathan Gresham.

title: Sucess
overview: Noé tells his partner, Camille, how he set out to sell a valuable item but ultimately returned empty-handed. Through a series of absurd encounters, and driven by an impeccable logic, he traded his possessions for others of lesser value, until he was left with nothing at all.

title: Tavvai
overview: In 1880, A Maharaj through his atrocities invited Tavvai. The village is terrified for generations until a chosen one sets things right.

title: Disney Celebrates America: The Pursuit of Happiness
overview: A coast-to-coast event exploring Disney Parks and attractions as a portal through which America's greatest stories, triumphs and traditions are celebrated.

title: Sleeping Giants
overview: Inside the ancient ruins of a Sleeping Giant, adventuring friends 2-BIT and Oggy awaken a cute and harmless looking robot, Hopper, only to find it’s a villainous AI with delusions of grandeur.

title: The Day Diego Returned to the Azteca
overview: The Day Diego Returned to the Azteca, a new ESPN Films documentary revisiting Diego Armando Maradona’s only return to Estadio Azteca in 2000, 14 years after leading Argentina to its historic World Cup win, is now streaming on Disney+ in the U.S. and in select international markets. It will make its linear debut July 3 at 10 p.m. ET on ESPN2 and ESPN Deportes.  The film tells the extraordinary and little-known story of Diego Armando Maradona’s only return to Estadio Azteca after leading Argentina to the 1986 FIFA World Cup title. Maradona returned to the stadium in 2000 while traveling from Cuba to Mexico for Boca Juniors’ Copa Libertadores semifinal against Club América.

title: Source Connection
overview: When an investigative reporter shows up to meet her source, he proves reticent at first, but then gives the information she's looking for. Together they're working to uncover the ills of the city.

title: Fantasia
overview: In a mysterious music venue, Luan makes a living performing erotic shows for mysterious men. When a sinister client appears, he discovers the fine line between dreams and nightmares.

title: Louis C.K.: Ridiculous
overview: From a bee getting shot in New York City to paying strangers to take his aging father, Louis C.K. unleashes the ridiculous thoughts in his mind.

title: PL Stories: Diogo Jota
overview: A year has passed since Diogo Jota's tragic death. Through interviews with friends, family, and former coaches, we look back at his significance and legacy both on and off the pitch.

title: Bliss: Beyond the Edge of Time
overview: Six animation directors draw on the six lines of the I Ching to create distinct shorts rooted in Taiwanese vernacular culture. Blending tradition and futurity, faith and emotion, and science fiction with reality, these intersecting visions spiral toward a cold, fantastical romance in an animated void reminiscent of Black Mirror.
